name: Longformly
summary: Turns a script into a finished long YouTube-style video with narration, scenes, motion and sound, after a free preview.
description: Longformly is a long-form AI video generator for YouTube: you paste a script and get a finished video up to 60 minutes, with narration, scenes, gentle motion and sound. There is no subscription. Failed renders are never charged.

pricing.details: Free 10-second preview; 9 € per video (first video 6 €), up to 60 minutes; no subscription.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Script to finished long-form video (up to 60 minutes)

howToUse.title: Open longformly.com and paste your script.
howToUse.description: Open longformly.com and paste your script.

howToUse.title: Pay once for the full video if you want to keep it.
howToUse.description: Pay once for the full video if you want to keep it.
